visual_brief.subject: GitHub separates identity attribution from sensitive content capture in Copilot OpenTelemetry
verified_context: GitHub added opt-in user and machine attribution to Copilot OpenTelemetry: the authenticated GitHub login, local operating-system account, and machine name.
Identity capture remains independent from prompt and response content.
Administrators can independently control capture of prompts, responses, tool arguments, tool output, and policy details, and every class is off by default.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A useful agent trace can pass through a controlled observation path while identity attribution and sensitive content remain governed by separate physical shutters.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A single trace travels through two distinct architectural iris gates: one exposes a restrained terracotta identity marker while the other keeps a dense paper-and-ink content core sealed, making the separation of attribution and content control visible without turning the image into a diagram.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. The thin trace passes through a compact terracotta-centered iris and a clearly separate stone shutter before reaching a sealed paper content mass; the quiet architectural landscape, material restraint, and negative space closely match both production references.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. Separate levers make independent controls legible and the content mass is strong, but the bright trace and pointed output read closer to a schematic signal device than the quieter golden references.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The top-down canal and separated gates communicate the control sequence, but the tighter crop and luminous trace provide less negative space and a weaker responsive-cover silhouette than candidate A.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1600 x 900 crop preserves the full trace, both separate shutters, the terracotta identity marker, and the sealed paper content mass with generous parchment space above and below.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop retains the terracotta-centered iris and the independent stone shutter as the principal relationship while still showing the trace between them.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 480 x 270, the two contrasting circular gates, thin dark trace, terracotta marker, and bound paper block remain distinct without relying on fine surface detail.

golden_reference_comparison: Direct comparison with the September Copilot OpenTelemetry and review-controls references shows the same warm paper ground, charcoal-and-brass line language, sparing terracotta accent, sculptural architectural mass, and calm negative space. Candidate A advances the earlier observability metaphor with two physically separate shutters and a sealed content block rather than repeating its multi-stream composition.
